title: Pennsylvania Mutiny of 1783
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Pennsylvania Mutiny of 1783", at revision 1366233368, opens: "The Pennsylvania Mutiny of 1783 was an anti-government protest by nearly 400 soldiers of the Continental Army in June 1783. The mutiny, and the refusal of the Executive Council of Pennsylvania to stop it, ultimately resulted in Congress of the Confederation vacating Philadelphia and the creation of a federal district, ultimately developed as Washington, D.C., to serve as the national capital." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7164013, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1783 protest of soldiers of the American Revolution who had not been paid". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
